description: Sessions held out for the fMRI analysis. Never used for reasoning traces, agent training or validation. Read by every script that splits data.
rule: Per subject, sessions sorted by name; hold out every 5th (positions 5, 10, 15, ...). Then, for every level missing from a subject's held-out sessions, add the nearest session (by position) to a held-out one that contains that level; ties broken by bringing the subject's held-out play share closest to 20%.

adjustments.sub-03: w1l2 missing from positions 5,10,15,20,25; added ses-025 (position 24, next to held-out ses-026; tied with ses-010, ses-015, ses-020 at distance 1; ses-025 brings the share closest to 20%).
